acceptance: The fork change that introduced it is identified and its intent stated.
Executed tests compare Snowflake/Databricks-shaped SQL ordering against the reference engine for NULL sort keys (Spark in fork CI for Databricks).
Affected published bundles are listed; flagged or noted per provenance policy if values or order changed.
description: The published-results audit found that, since v0.4.1, translated SQL for Snowflake and Databricks turns DESC into DESC NULLS LAST (e.g. TSBS queries, DataVault Q11). No reviewed PR's published-impact section names it. Default NULL placement for DESC differs by engine (PostgreSQL and Snowflake place NULLs first; Spark/Databricks and DuckDB place them last), so the explicit NULLS LAST is a no-op on Databricks but can change order, and LIMIT membership, on Snowflake whenever the sort key has NULLs. Decide which placement matches the source dialect each benchmark is written in and the benchmark's intent.
